text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon achieved a splendid Make a 
Debut. She was overflowing with 
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had a rival she longed to face 
one-on-one on the big stage someday: 
Narita Brian, her peer and the top 
contender for the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To make that dream come true, Hishi Amazon 
wanted to climb even higher. Next, she 
will take on the Junior-tier GⅠ, the 
Hanshin JF...!
